values.name: Guillaume Bourdila
values.bio: Guillaume Bourdila is a French freediver from Ramonville-Saint-Agne. A pool specialist, he became world champion and set the AIDA world record in Dynamic with Bi-Fins at the 2025 AIDA Freediving World Championship in Wakayama, Japan. He has also set CMAS world records in Dynamic with Bi-Fins and Dynamic No Fins, and holds French national records.
